columns.validationmsg: 'Sale Price should be greater than zero'
columns.name: saleprice

columns.validationmsg: "Item flat disc should be equal or greater than zero"
columns.name: itemflatdisc

columns.validationmsg: 'Claimable Discount % value should be between 0 and 100'
columns.name: claimablediscperc

table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	AdvSaleDetail.AdvSaleInvCode,   
	gcode=AdvSaleDetail.gcode,   
	icode=AdvSaleDetail.icode,   
	batch=AdvSaleDetail.batch,   
	expiry=AdvSaleDetail.expiry,   
	manfdate=AdvSaleDetail.manfdate,
	rowgroup=AdvSaleDetail.rowgroup,
	Id = AdvSaleDetail.IDENTITYCOL,   
	looseqty = AdvSaleDetail.looseqty,
	packqty  = AdvSaleDetail.packqty,
	packunits= AdvSaleDetail.packunits,
	saleprice= AdvSaleDetail.saleprice,
	discperc = AdvSaleDetail.discperc,  
	rate     = AdvSaleDetail.rate,  
	avgprice = AdvSaleDetail.avgprice,  
	Due      = AdvSaleDetail.Due,
	itemflatdisc = AdvSaleDetail.itemflatdisc,
	SatisfiedDate = AdvSaleDetail.SatisfiedDate,
	packqtyforsale = AdvSaleDetail.packqtyforsale,
	bonuspackqtyforsale = AdvSaleDetail.bonuspackqtyforsale,
	stock = 0.0000, 
	packingdesc=space(50),
	totalstock = 0.0000,
	packprice = AdvSaleDetail.packprice,
	purunitrate = AdvSaleDetail.purunitrate,
	rppunitrate = AdvSaleDetail.rppunitrate,
	saleutn = AdvSaleDetail.SaleUtn,
	SaleItemDescription =  AdvSaleDetail.SaleItemDescription,
	DescICode =  AdvSaleDetail.DescICode,
	claimable=AdvSaleDetail.claimable,
	claimablediscperc=AdvSaleDetail.claimablediscperc,
	balancestock=AdvSaleDetail.balancestock,
	unitsalestax=AdvSaleDetail.unitsalestax,
	gstperc=AdvSaleDetail.gstperc,
	bonusqty=AdvSaleDetail.bonusqty
FROM 
	AdvSaleDetail
WHERE 
	( dbo.AdvSaleDetail.AdvSaleInvCode = :ar_AdvSaleInvCode )
ORDER BY 
	AdvSaleDetail.IDENTITYCOL

objects.name: c_detaildwtotal
objects.expression: sum((  ( looseqty *  saleprice  )  +   ( packqty *  saleprice * packunits ) ) *  ( 1-  (  discperc  *  .01 )  )  for all)
